feature: slim_rejected_tapes (disk saving): after an all8_both_seeds decision's per-seed admission is sealed, every explicitly REJECTED candidate branch tape (and its extended-window branch) is reduced to a small SLIM.json; the full RESULT.json + RESULT.json.gz are removed (live path) or moved with sha256 verification (one-off migration). DEFAULT OFF.
files: tools/coopmwm/verify_perseed.py (slim_rejected_tapes kwarg on confirm_all8/confirm_pending_all8; slim_record runs AFTER the record is sealed)
tools/coopmwm/replay_bank.py (confirm_pending passes slim_rejected_tapes through to the all8 path only)
tools/coopmwm/bank_statistics.py (_read_result: SLIM.json fallback - exact per-second stats reconstruction when the full tape was slimmed)

slim_rejected_tapes.default: OFF (parameter None + env unset -> nothing written or removed anywhere; byte-identical, tested)
where: None reads env C4NM_SLIM_REJECTED_TAPES=='1' (same convention as C4NM_V2V)

what_is_slimmed_vs_kept.slimmed: per sealed all8 record: each example with admitted=False AND status='rejected' (data_missing keeps its tape) on seed 1 (first verification) and seed 2 (confirm_seed2_all8), plus that candidate's branch in its seed's extended verification (confirm_extended_all8 / confirm_extended_seed2_all8)
kept: ADMITTED (plan, seed) plan-branch tapes (imitation: bank_pairs per_seed_v1, bank_examples, imitation_entry)
policy REFERENCE tapes of every verification (grading/bootstrap, relabel_reference_mismatch, coopfix_exact_gate reference_adopted)
the first-seed CHOSEN branch even when seed 1 rejected it (legacy bank_pairs/lesson _action_error readers)
all solo tapes (confirm_solo_all8_s1/s2) and every observable.jsonl.gz trace
the sealed record itself (byte-identical, re-verified after slimming) and all receipts
what_is_slimmed_vs_kept.slim_json: per branch: verification-window per-second cumulative team_delay_vs series (branch_eval.totals_at-compatible floats, bit-exact round-trip), J_veh_s/status/actual_sim_s/result_sha256/payload_sha256, per-vehicle window outcomes when the tape carried them, sealed 'slim_sha256'; integrity-checked against the sealed receipt's result_sha256 on every read

reader_audit: grep RESULT.json/branches_dir/tape readers across bank_statistics, replay_bank (bank_pairs/bank_examples/lesson/_action_error), verify_perseed (relabel/bank_examples/imitation_entry), exact_grade, policy_synergy, coopfix_exact_gate (state_receipts/certified_candidates): after sealing, NO reader opens a non-admitted candidate tape; the kept list above covers every post-seal read; unexpected future reads still work via the bank_statistics._read_result SLIM fallback (bit-identical per-second stats, sealed-admission equality tested)

migration.quote: python -m tools.coopmwm.slim_tapes quote --root R --arm B   (read-only bytes-saved quote)
migration.rule: one-off for EXISTING sealed decisions: copies RESULT.json(.gz) into the bank-relative archive layout, sha256-verifies the copies (file digests + decompressed payload vs marker sha + sealed result digest), writes SLIM.json into the branch dir, only then drops the source; never deletes without verification, never touches admitted/reference/solo tapes; any failure restores the branch untouched; archive dir must be outside the bank (operator rsyncs the target to another host)

cpuQ_enable_steps: merge c4/slim-tapes; nothing changes until the option is turned on (default OFF, byte-identical)
live: set C4NM_SLIM_REJECTED_TAPES=1 (or pass slim_rejected_tapes=True) for the trainer/confirm_pending process running verify_mode=all8_both_seeds
existing sealed decisions: run the quote CLI, rsync the archive target to the other host, then run migrate WITHOUT --dry-run (idempotent; full_restored dirs are reported and skipped)
